programme.title: Dark Arts TV
programme.desc: The Dark Arts TV team ventures into the Old Hospital on College Hill, deep in the Appalachian Mountains, a place steeped in a long history of hauntings where shadowy presences, unexplained phenomena, and whispers of unknown evils linger in the darkness, waiting to be discovered. What will they encounter in the shadows—and will they leave unchanged?

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: While shooting pool in a Louisiana bar, Andre Daigle meets a beautiful and mysterious woman. That night he disappears. With no clues to go on, Andre's family calls in psychic Rosemarie Kerr - whose remarkable visions provide answers to a baffling crime. In New Jersey, a teenage girl vanishes while walking home from school. Witnesses saw her walking near a young man whose alibi is shaky. But police have no evidence and must release the suspect - who then vanishes himself. Psychic Nancy Orlen Weber joins the case and offers uncannily accurate descriptions of the crime, the suspect - and where he's hiding.

programme.title: Encounters

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Richard examines the growing UFO Disclosure movement and its attempts to force the US Government to reveal to the public what it knows about UFOs and aliens. Interviews include a noted historian who uncovered numerous declassified documents demonstrating the U.S. Government, the military and the intelligence community are concerned about the UFO phenomenon; and Canada's former minister of defence who says he has it on good authority that officials within the U.S. Government have met face-to-face with extraterrestrials.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: On this episode the team investigate the RSS Discovery, RRS Discovery is a barque-rigged auxiliary steamship built in Dundee, Scotland for Antarctic research. Launched in 1901, she was the last traditional wooden three-masted ship to be built in the United Kingdom. Her first mission was the British National Antarctic Expedition, carrying Robert Falcon Scott and Ernest Shackleton on their first, and highly successful, journey to the Antarctic, known as the Discovery Expedition.
